card.name: Partway through split drug and term names
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle of a split-up drug name or term, such as the 'ih' in Dihydroergotamine or 'pop' in Epoprostenol. It also fires on a word right after a drug name, such as 'tablets' or 'therapy'.

modes.label: Inside split drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug or technical name that is split into several parts.

modes.label: Dosage-form word after drug name
modes.description: The word tablets or therapy right after a named drug.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue pazopanib<< tablets>> in patients unable to tolerate the second dose

modes.label: Start of a web address
modes.description: The http at the start of a link in a reference sentence.
